cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Drop the Armor
cards.instruction: Persuade someone to lower their guard, stop performing strength, or admit what affects them.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You've said you're managing three times over dinner. That's a conclusion, not an answer. What happens when you get home?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I put the television on so the flat sounds occupied.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then invite a person. Me, for example. Please ask directly instead of describing the television schedule.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Come tomorrow. I'll cook something nice. I promise I won't be miserable.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Remove the promise and ask again. An invitation doesn't need a warranty. I'll come for toast and whatever mood you're actually in.
